cisceNodes: c3_geo_003 (Continents - introduction), c3_geo_004 (Oceans - introduction), c3_geo_005 (India on the globe)
mascotDescription: a friendly ship captain with a captain's hat, a spyglass, a steering wheel, and an anchor pin. Custom SVG, not an owl.
sceneDescription: world map scene with sky gradient, a large globe showing continents and oceans, a ship sailing, and India highlighted on the map
challengeTypes: identify: What is a CONTINENT? (A very large area of land vs A small island vs A type of ocean)
identify: How many continents are there on Earth? (7 vs 5 vs 10)

sort: Drag each continent to its correct description (Asia: largest continent, India is here | Africa: second largest, has Sahara desert | Europe: small continent with many countries | North America: has USA and Canada | South America: has Amazon rainforest | Australia: smallest continent, also an island | Antarctica: coldest, covered in ice)
identify: Which is the LARGEST continent? (Asia vs Australia vs Europe)

sort: Drag each ocean to its correct description (Pacific: largest and deepest ocean | Atlantic: between Americas and Europe/Africa | Indian: south of India, warm waters | Arctic: smallest, frozen, near north pole | Southern: around Antarctica)
identify: Which ocean is named after India? (Indian Ocean vs Pacific Ocean vs Atlantic Ocean)

sort: Drag each fact about India on the globe to True or False (True: India is in Asia, India is surrounded by Indian Ocean, India is a large country | False: India is a continent, India is in Africa, India is the smallest country)
sort: Drag each place to Continent or Ocean (Continent: Asia, Africa, Europe, Australia, Antarctica | Ocean: Pacific, Atlantic, Indian, Arctic, Southern)
extraInstructions: IMPORTANT: You MUST import and use BOTH audioManager AND speechManager. Import speechManager from '../../../lib/sim-engine/speech'. Use audioManager.play() for sound effects (valid: pickup, drop-correct, drop-wrong, tap, success, error, celebration, hint). Use speechManager.speak() for spoken teaching slide narration, challenge questions, correct/incorrect feedback, and hints. The game must teach: (1) Continents — a continent is a very large continuous area of land. There are 7 continents: Asia (largest, India is in Asia), Africa (second largest, Sahara desert), Europe (many small countries), North America (USA, Canada), South America (Amazon rainforest), Australia (smallest continent, also an island), Antarctica (coldest, covered in ice, no permanent residents). (2) Oceans — an ocean is a huge body of salt water. There are 5 oceans: Pacific (largest and deepest), Atlantic (between Americas and Europe/Africa), Indian (south of India, named after India), Arctic (smallest, frozen, near north pole), Southern (around Antarctica). Oceans cover about 2/3 of Earth. (3) India on the globe — India is in Asia (the largest continent). India is surrounded by the Indian Ocean to the south. India is a large country with many states. India's capital is New Delhi. India is north of the equator. On a globe, India looks like a triangle pointing down. Misconceptions: 'India is a continent' (India is a country IN the continent of Asia), 'Australia is only an island' (Australia is both a continent AND an island — it is the smallest continent), 'Antarctica has many people living there' (Antarctica is covered in ice, only scientists visit temporarily), 'the Pacific and Atlantic are the same ocean' (they are separate — Pacific is largest, Atlantic is between Americas and Europe/Africa), 'there are only 5 continents' (there are 7 continents — some people count 5 by combining Americas and Europe/Asia, but the standard is 7). Default width=720, height=560. Use named export (export function ContinentsGame), NOT export default. Export interface ContinentsGameProps with width?, height?, onComplete?: (score: number) => void.
